name: CVQA
description: CVQA is a culturally-diverse multilingual visual question answering benchmark dataset covering 26 languages and 11 scripts from 28 countries across four continents. It includes culturally-driven images and questions to evaluate multimodal models' cultural bias and linguistic diversity.
reputation: A recent multilingual cultural VQA benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating cultural bias and linguistic diversity in multimodal models.
notes: Focuses on cultural and linguistic diversity with native speakers and cultural experts involved in data collection; challenging for current state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs.
